paite: Ngai in, ka mit in hiai tengteng amu a, ka bil in huai za in atheisiamta hi.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

paite: Na thei uh, huai mah ke'n leng ka thei a, nou sang in ka niamzaw kei hi.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang ah thu ka gen mahmah ding, Pathian toh houlim ka ut hi.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

paite: Himahleh nou zuau phuakte na hi ua, phattuamna bei damdawisiam na hi vek uhi.
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

paite: Aw na vek un dai sipsip le uchin maw; na pilna uh hi ding hiven.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

paite: "Tu in ka thusut za un, ka mukte ngetna ngaikhia un.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

paite: Pathian a ding in dikloutak in thu na gen ding uam, amah a ding in khemhattak in na houlim ding uam?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

paite: Ami na zahtak ding uam? Pathian a ding in na sual ding uam?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

paite: Nou ahon zonkhiak ahoih hia? Ahihkeileh mi'n mi akhem bang in, amah na khem ding uam?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

paite: Nou ahon sal mahmah ding, aguk a mite na zahtak uleh.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

paite: Ahoih tungtuanna in nou ahon lausak kei dia hia, nou tung ah akihtakhuaina ake kei diam?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

paite: Na thupilte uh vut bang lel ahi, manna bei paunak ahi a, na kidalnate uh tungman kidalnate ahi.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

paite: Dai unla, thu ka gentheihna ding in, hon omsak maimai un, ka tung ah ahong tung ding hong tung hen.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

paite: "Bangziak a ka ha in ka sa kei a, ka khut a ka hinna koih ding ahia?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

paite: Ama'n hon that mahleh, amah ka ngak lai ding; ama ah ka lampite ka kemhoih lailai ding hi.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

paite: Hiai leng ka hotdamna ahi ding; Pathian limsakloumi ama a hong pai lou ding ahih ziak in.
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

paite: Ka thugen thanuamtak in za un, ka thupuanna na bil sung uah om hen.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

paite: Ngai un, tu in ka thu ka bawlhoihta a; ka diktat ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

paite: "Kei hon kiselpih ding amah kua ahia? Kei tu in ka dai dia kha ka khah ding hi.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

paite: Ka tung ah thil nih hih kei phot le uchin, huchi in na mai a kipan ka bu kei ding hi.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

paite: Kei a pan gamlapi ah na khut kaikik in; na lauhuaina in hon lausak ke'n.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

paite: "Huai chiang in hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding; ahihkeileh hon pausak inla, hon dawng in.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate leh khelhnate bang ahia? Ka tatlekna leh ka khelhna hon theisak in.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

paite: Bangziak a na mai sel a na melma dia hon bawl na hia?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

paite: Singnah mutleng na hihbuai dia hia? Buhpawl keu na delh dia hia?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

paite: "Nang lah kei dem in khatak in na gelh a, ka tuailai thulimlouhnate na hon luahsak hi.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

paite: Ka khete leng kol na bunsak a, ka lampite tengteng na chiamteh hi; ka khenuai kim ah gi na khung hi.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

paite: Mihing zaw thilmuat leh nget nekgawp puansilh bang in amangthang hi."
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
